title: 第23章 狂怒的叶凡第24章 你爹能当皇帝是因为我爹不想当皇帝
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
lines: 与此同时，唐门分舵外，马车里。
“小弟，要我出面吗？”
“不用！这点小事，我能搞定！”叶凡头也不回的跳下马车，直接冲进唐门分舵，几个唐门之人还不知死活，想阻拦这个大夏第一纨绔。
“站住，这里是唐门分舵！”
叶凡只有一句话：“王大年，谁敢阻拦，直接打死丢出去喂狗！”
看到王大年等几百个禁卫军，唐门分舵之人吓得一哆嗦！
没有一个人敢上前阻拦。
耳边传来唐妙衣的惨叫声，叶凡一口气冲进大殿。
“叶凡！”
见到叶凡的那一刻，李悠然吃了一惊，没想到他居然来了。
“我去你妈的！”
叶凡怒骂一声，抬脚踹翻两个动刑的人，救下唐妙衣。
唐妙衣很意外：“你怎么来了？”
叶凡低头看了一眼，唐妙衣十分青葱玉指，扭曲变形，算是彻底废了。
心中顿时涌出一股恼火的情绪，唐妙衣可以手搓巴雷特，ak47也全靠她手搓，这么完美的一双手，居然就这么废了！！！
心中窝火极了！
“整个大夏，谁不知道你是我的人？”叶凡怒道。
他的意思，唐妙衣是她手下的工匠！
但唐妙衣却误会了，苍白的俏脸闪过一抹血色：“你……乱说什么！”
“你就是镇北王叶凡？”
唐七对于突然出现的叶凡和冲进来的禁卫军，并不害怕。
唐门势力庞大，整个大夏没人敢动唐门的人！
“叶凡，这是我们唐门的私事，请你立刻离开！”八长老和九长老沉着脸。
对于这个大夏第一的废物纨绔，他们早有耳闻！
叶凡直接无视。
看着唐妙衣的手，心疼无比！老子的还要批量生产ak啊！
“是谁下令，对你手指动刑的？”
“是我！”
不等唐妙衣回答，唐七居然主动的站出来，脸上挂着淡淡的不屑。
叶凡抬起头，眼睛里全是狂怒！
三个字，几乎从叶凡的牙缝里挤出来：“把他的手指，给我全部砍掉喂狗！”
“是，王爷。”
content_en:
At the same time, Tangmen was outside the helm and in the carriage.
"Brother, do you want me to come forward?"
"No need! I can handle this little thing!" Ye Fan jumped off the carriage without looking back and rushed straight into the Tang Sect's helm. Several Tang Sect people didn't know whether to live or die and wanted to stop the number one dude in Daxia.
"Stop, this is the Tangmen branch!"
Ye Fan only had one sentence: "Wang Danian, whoever dares to stop him will be beaten to death and thrown out to feed the dogs!"
Seeing Wang Danian and hundreds of imperial guards, the people in charge of the Tang Sect were trembling with fear!
No one dared to step forward to stop him.
"Ah——!"
Tang Miaoyi's screams came to his ears, and Ye Fan rushed into the hall in one breath.
"Ye Fan!"
The moment she saw Mark, Li Youran was surprised. She didn't expect him to come.
"Fuck you!"
Ye Fan cursed angrily, raised his foot and kicked over the two torturers, saving Tang Miaoyi.
Tang Miaoyi was surprised: "Why are you here?"
Ye Fan lowered his head and took a look. Tang Miaoyi was very green, twisted and deformed. He was completely useless.
A surge of irritation suddenly emerged in her heart. Tang Miaoyi could rub Barrett with her hands, and the AK47 could also be rubbed with her hands. Such perfect hands were so useless! ! !
I feel so angry!
"Who in the entire Daxia doesn't know that you are mine?" Ye Fan said angrily.
What he meant was that Tang Miaoyi was her craftsman!
But Tang Miaoyi misunderstood, and a flash of blood flashed across her pale pretty face: "You...are talking nonsense!"
"Are you Ye Fan, King of Zhenbei?"
Tang Qi was not afraid of the sudden appearance of Ye Fan and the imperial guards who rushed in.
The Tang Sect is so powerful that no one in Daxia dares to touch the Tang Sect’s people!
"Ye Fan, this is our Tang Sect's private matter, please leave immediately!" The Eighth Elder and the Ninth Elder had a solemn expression.
They have already heard about this great loser in the Xia Dynasty!
Ye Fan ignored it directly.
Looking at Tang Miaoyi's hand, I feel extremely distressed! I still need to mass produce ak!
"Who gave the order to torture your fingers?"
"It's me!"
Without waiting for Tang Miaoyi to answer, Tang Qi actually stepped forward with a touch of disdain on his face.
Ye Fan raised his head, his eyes full of rage!
"King! Big! Nian!"
Three words were almost squeezed out from Ye Fan's teeth: "Cut off all his fingers and feed them to the dogs!"
"Yes, Your Majesty."
